title: A.R.M.O.R. planned-maintenance signal of a node
description: Published by a node to armor/control/{node_id}/maintenance, RETAINED (the only retained message of the control family), just before it goes quiet on purpose: a restart, a pause, a standby, a firmware update, a firmware upload or an operator window. `active` true says the node expects to be quiet (for about `expected_s` seconds when given); `active` false clears it and is published retained too, so that the broker never keeps a stale `active`. The server treats an active signal as the reason for an expected silence and holds back the node-offline alert, but only up to its own bound: a stuck or hostile node cannot silence the alerts for ever.

active.description: true: the node is about to be quiet; false: it is back (or the window ended).

expected_s.description: How long the node expects to be quiet. Only with active true.
